title: CCTV & video surveillance
summary: IP camera systems planned for full coverage, with recording, remote viewing and the storage you need.
intro: Security cameras that cover what matters and stay out of the way. We plan camera positions from your floor plans, install IP cameras, recorders and video management software, and set up remote viewing so your team can check any camera from the security desk or a phone.

points.title: Coverage planned on drawings
points.text: Camera positions and angles planned for entrances, corridors, cash points and stores, with no blind spots.

points.title: Clear images, day and night
points.text: IP cameras chosen for each location, including low-light and wide-angle views.

points.title: Recording you can rely on
points.text: Storage sized to the number of days you need to keep footage.

points.title: Watch from anywhere
points.text: Live and recorded views on a monitor, at the security desk or on a phone.

includes: IP dome, bullet and fisheye cameras
Network video recorders (NVR) and video management software
Storage sized to your retention period

faqs.question: How long can footage be kept?
faqs.answer: As long as you need. We size the recorders and storage to the number of cameras, the image quality and the number of days you must keep footage.

metaDescription: CCTV and IP video surveillance for offices, showrooms and commercial spaces in Mumbai: coverage planning, recording and remote viewing.
